doc: One collision shape, in a body's own space (metres; +Y up, the model's ground at y = 0): one of the shapes Jolt Physics knows (design/spine.md, Layer 1). A body is a compound of these.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Which shape. A capsule, tapered capsule, and cylinder run along their rotated +Y axis.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Axis-angle: the rotation axis scaled by the angle in radians (zero: unrotated).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Sphere, capsule, and cylinder radius; a tapered capsule's bottom radius, metres.

fields.name: radius_top
fields.doc: A tapered capsule's top radius, metres.

fields.name: half_height
fields.doc: Half the height of a capsule's or tapered capsule's straight part, or of a cylinder, metres.

fields.name: half_extents
fields.doc: A box's half size on each axis, metres.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: A convex hull's points, metres (the hull is built from them).
